title: PersonaCR ops measurements (memory, embedding batches, analyze time, Claude review cost)

setup.cluster: minikube v1.35.1, docker driver, node capped at 6 GiB (Docker Desktop on WSL2, Windows 11 laptop, 15.6 GB RAM)
setup.backend_limit: 3 GiB memory limit (k8s/backend.yaml); worker has the same 3 GiB limit
setup.runs: single run per configuration; not repeated, no variance estimate

provenance_levels.archived_log: raw sampler / curl / job JSON output was captured to a file during the run; values copied here verbatim
provenance_levels.offline_recount: re-derived offline from the repo + tokenizer, no embedding (reproducible)
provenance_levels.session_only: seen in kubectl output during the session; the raw output was not saved and pod logs were lost on restart

caveat_on_before_after: The 'before' and 'after' analyze runs differ in THREE changes, not one: (1) token-budget batching padding fix (eb63cb4), (2) MAX_EMBED_TOKENS 2048 -> 1024 (279eb11), (3) MiniLM no longer preloaded at startup (079c2de). The deltas below are their combined effect and must not be attributed to batching alone.

before.config: image with padding bug (every batch = 1 chunk), MAX_EMBED_TOKENS=2048, MiniLM preloaded at API startup

backend_memory_at_start_MiB.note: first sampler reading, before Jina loaded

backend_memory_peak_MiB.note: 219 samples at >= 3000 MiB; cgroup memory.current includes page cache

embedding_batches.corroboration: offline_recount with the buggy counter also gives 493 (eb63cb4)

analyze_wall_time_s.note: 22:21:42Z request start to 22:51:19Z 200 OK in the backend log; embedding phase 22:23:01 -> 22:51:18 (28.3 min)

earlier_failure.value: OOMKilled (exit 137) at the 3 GiB limit on 2026-10-01, before token-budget batching

backend_memory_idle_MiB.note: cgroup reading before the request; kubectl top showed 198Mi (session_only)

backend_memory_peak_MiB.note: 236 samples; cgroup memory.peak read afterwards = 1446 MiB (session_only); oom_kill=0

embedding_probe_in_backend_image.note: fastembed Jina v2, docker run in the backend image; before the cap a ~3k-token text peaked +1.6 GiB over a 0.9 GiB baseline and a ~7.5k-token text was SIGKILLed with no memory limit; with the 2048 cap, 1/4/32 x 30k-char files peaked at 1.62-1.73 GiB under --memory=3g

claude_review.path: POST /api/reviews -> RQ worker pod (fingerprint + 493-vector collection reused, no re-analyze)

llm_calls.note: llm_usage in the job result; HTTP statuses from the worker log (session_only)

estimated_cost_usd.note: list price $1/MTok input + $5/MTok output; an estimate, not a billed amount

client_time_s.note: POST to completed, polling every 3 s

claude_review.note_on_cost: iterations=2: Loop 1 re-ran style/defect/QA with unchanged inputs, so 6 of the 7 calls were 3 calls made twice (fixed in a later commit).
